decisions.reason: God promised land from the wilderness to the Euphrates (Genesis 15:18; Exodus 23:31; 11:24). As the land grows, more households will live far from the chosen place (verse 21).

decisions.choice: your soul desires: you have an appetite
decisions.reason: The "soul" is the living person with his hunger and wants. The craving is not blamed; it is simply allowed.

decisions.choice: let me eat meat: the wish of the speaker
decisions.reason: The verb form expresses a wish or resolve: "I want to eat meat".

decisions.choice: promised; you are longing / you are hungry; whenever you want
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "promised" for "spoken", which is its sense here, and put "your soul" as "you" and "the desire of your soul" as "whenever you want". Literal keeps "soul".

decisions.choice: The LORD your God will make your land larger ... Then
decisions.reason: Readable turns the long "when" sentence into three short ones.

source.text: כִּֽי־יִרְחַ֨ק מִמְּךָ֜ הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִבְחַ֜ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶיךָ֮ לָשׂ֣וּם שְׁמ֣וֹ שָׁם֒ וְזָבַחְתָּ֞ מִבְּקָרְךָ֣ וּמִצֹּֽאנְךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לְךָ֔ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוִּיתִ֑ךָ וְאָֽכַלְתָּ֙ בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל אַוַּ֥ת נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: If is far from you the place which will choose Yahweh your God to put his name there, then you may slaughter from your herd and from your flock which has given Yahweh to you, as I commanded you, and you may eat in your gates in all [the] desire of your soul.

en.L: If the place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will choose to put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name there is too far from you, then you may slaughter from your herd and from your flock that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has given you, as I have commanded you, and you may eat within your gates with all the desire of your soul.
en.B: If the place where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God chooses to put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name is too far from you, you may slaughter animals from the herds and flocks that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has given you, as I have commanded you, and eat them in your own towns whenever you wish.
en.R: The place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God chooses for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name may be too far away from you. If so, you may kill some of the cattle, sheep or goats that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has given you, in the way I have told you. Then you may eat the meat in your own town whenever you want.

es.L: Si está demasiado lejos de ti el lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios escogerá para poner allí {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, entonces podrás sacrificar de tu ganado mayor y de tu ganado menor que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ha dado, como te he mandado, y podrás comer dentro de tus puertas conforme a todo el deseo de tu alma.
es.B: Si el lugar donde {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios escoja poner {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre está demasiado lejos de ti, podrás matar animales de las manadas y los rebaños que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ha dado, como te he mandado, y comerlos en tus ciudades siempre que quieras.
es.R: Puede ser que el lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios escoja para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre esté demasiado lejos de ti. Si es así, puedes matar algunas de las vacas, ovejas o cabras que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ha dado, de la manera que te he indicado. Luego puedes comer la carne en tu ciudad siempre que quieras.

fr.L: Si le lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu choisira pour y mettre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom est trop loin de toi, alors tu pourras abattre de ton gros bétail et de ton petit bétail que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a donné, comme je te l’ai commandé, et tu pourras manger dans tes portes selon tout le désir de ton âme.
fr.B: Si le lieu où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu choisit de mettre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom est trop loin de toi, tu pourras abattre des bêtes de ton gros et de ton petit bétail que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a donné, comme je te l’ai commandé, et les manger dans tes villes chaque fois que tu le voudras.
fr.R: Le lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu choisira pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom sera peut-être trop loin de chez toi. Dans ce cas, tu pourras tuer quelques-uns des bœufs, des moutons ou des chèvres que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a donnés, de la manière que je t’ai indiquée. Ensuite, tu pourras en manger la viande dans ta ville chaque fois que tu le voudras.

sw.L: Ikiwa mahali atakapopachagua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ili kuweka jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} huko ni mbali mno nawe, ndipo utaweza kuchinja katika ng'ombe wako na katika kondoo wako ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekupa, kama nilivyokuamuru, nawe utaweza kula ndani ya malango yako kwa kila tamaa ya nafsi yako.
sw.B: Ikiwa mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anachagua kuweka jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni mbali mno nawe, unaweza kuchinja wanyama kutoka katika makundi ya ng'ombe na kondoo ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekupa, kama nilivyokuamuru, na kuwala katika miji yako wakati wowote unapotaka.
sw.R: Huenda mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atapachagua kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} pakawa mbali sana nawe. Ikiwa ndivyo, unaweza kuchinja baadhi ya ng'ombe, kondoo au mbuzi ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekupa, kwa namna niliyokuambia. Kisha unaweza kula nyama hiyo katika mji wako wakati wowote unapotaka.

decisions.choice: if it is far from you: too far to bring every animal for slaughter
decisions.reason: The verse explains the permission of verse 15. A household far from the chosen place cannot bring each animal it wants to eat there, so it may kill it at home.

decisions.choice: as I have commanded you: in the way already laid down
alternatives: according to a rule of slaughter not recorded here
decisions.reason: The phrase most likely points to the rules just given, above all that the blood is poured out and not eaten (verse 16). It may also refer to a way of slaughter that is not written down here.

decisions.choice: may be too far away ... If so
decisions.reason: Readable splits the condition into its own sentence.

source.text: אַ֗ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵאָכֵ֤ל אֶֽת־הַצְּבִי֙ וְאֶת־הָ֣אַיָּ֔ל כֵּ֖ן תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ הַטָּמֵא֙ וְהַטָּה֔וֹר יַחְדָּ֖ו יֹאכְלֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely as is eaten the gazelle and the deer, so you shall eat it; the unclean and the clean alike may eat it.

en.L: Indeed, as the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you shall eat it; the unclean and the clean alike may eat it.
en.B: Eat it just as a gazelle or a deer is eaten; those who are ritually unclean and those who are clean may eat it alike.
en.R: Eat it the way you would eat a gazelle or a deer. People who are ritually clean and people who are not may both eat it.

es.L: Ciertamente, como se come la gacela y el ciervo, así la comerás; el impuro y el puro por igual la podrán comer.
es.B: Cómela tal como se come la gacela o el ciervo; los que están ritualmente impuros y los que están puros podrán comerla por igual.
es.R: Cómela como comerías gacela o ciervo. Pueden comerla tanto los que están ritualmente puros como los que no lo están.

fr.L: Toutefois, comme on mange la gazelle et le cerf, ainsi tu en mangeras ; l’impur et le pur en mangeront ensemble.
fr.B: Mange-la comme on mange la gazelle ou le cerf ; ceux qui sont rituellement impurs et ceux qui sont purs pourront en manger également.
fr.R: Mange-la comme tu mangerais de la gazelle ou du cerf. Ceux qui sont rituellement purs et ceux qui ne le sont pas peuvent tous en manger.

sw.L: Hakika, kama vile paa na kulungu wanavyoliwa, ndivyo utakavyoila; aliye najisi na aliye safi kwa pamoja wanaweza kuila.
sw.B: Ile kama vile paa au kulungu anavyoliwa; walio najisi kwa taratibu za ibada na walio safi wanaweza kuila vivyo hivyo.
sw.R: Ile kama ambavyo ungekula paa au kulungu. Watu walio safi kwa taratibu za ibada na wale wasio safi wanaweza wote kuila.

decisions.choice: as the gazelle and the deer; the unclean and the clean: as in verse 15
decisions.reason: The verse repeats verse 15: meat killed at home is like hunted game, not an offering, so ritual cleanness does not matter. See the note there.

decisions.choice: ritually unclean / ritually clean
decisions.reason: As in verse 15.

source.text: רַ֣ק חֲזַ֗ק לְבִלְתִּי֙ אֲכֹ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם כִּ֥י הַדָּ֖ם ה֣וּא הַנָּ֑פֶשׁ וְלֹא־תֹאכַ֥ל הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ עִם־הַבָּשָֽׂר׃

records.literal_gloss: Only be strong to not eat the blood, for the blood, it [is] the life, and not you shall eat the life with the meat.

en.L: Only be firm not to eat the blood, for the blood, it [is] the life, and you shall not eat the life with the meat.
en.B: Only be sure that you do not eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the meat.
en.R: But be very careful never to eat the blood. The blood is the life, and you must not eat the life along with the meat.

es.L: Solamente mantente firme en no comer la sangre, porque la sangre, ella [es] la vida, y no comerás la vida con la carne.
es.B: Solo asegúrate de no comer la sangre, porque la sangre es la vida, y no debes comer la vida junto con la carne.
es.R: Pero ten mucho cuidado de nunca comer la sangre. La sangre es la vida, y no debes comer la vida junto con la carne.

fr.L: Seulement, sois ferme pour ne pas manger le sang, car le sang, c’est la vie, et tu ne mangeras pas la vie avec la viande.
fr.B: Seulement, veille bien à ne pas manger le sang, car le sang, c’est la vie, et tu ne dois pas manger la vie avec la viande.
fr.R: Mais fais très attention à ne jamais manger le sang. Le sang, c’est la vie, et tu ne dois pas manger la vie avec la viande.

sw.L: Ila uwe imara usile damu, kwa maana damu, hiyo [ndiyo] uhai, wala usile uhai pamoja na nyama.
sw.B: Ila hakikisha kwamba huli damu, kwa sababu damu ndiyo uhai, nawe usile uhai pamoja na nyama.
sw.R: Lakini kuwa mwangalifu sana usile damu kamwe. Damu ndiyo uhai, nawe hupaswi kula uhai pamoja na nyama.

decisions.choice: be strong: hold firm, do not give way
decisions.reason: The verb means to be strong or resolute. The command is pressed hard because the freedom to eat meat at home, away from the altar, makes the ban easy to forget.

decisions.choice: the life: the living soul of the animal
decisions.reason: The word is the same as "soul" in verses 15, 20 and 21, here the life of a living creature. Blood is the life because it carries it (Genesis 9:4; Leviticus 17:11, 14).

decisions.choice: you shall not eat the life: life belongs to God
decisions.reason: Meat is God's gift to eat, but the life of the creature is his alone. Pouring out the blood gives the life back to him.

source.text: לֹ֖א תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ עַל־הָאָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖נּוּ כַּמָּֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall eat it; on the ground you shall pour it like water.

en.L: You shall not eat it; on the ground you shall pour it out like water.
en.B: Do not eat it; pour it out on the ground like water.
en.R: Do not eat it. Pour it out on the ground like water.

es.L: No la comerás; sobre la tierra la derramarás como agua.
es.B: No la comas; derrámala en la tierra como agua.
es.R: No la comas. Derrámala en el suelo como agua.

fr.L: Tu ne le mangeras pas ; sur la terre tu le répandras comme de l’eau.
fr.B: Ne le mange pas ; répands-le sur le sol comme de l’eau.
fr.R: Ne le mange pas. Verse-le sur le sol comme de l’eau.

sw.L: Usiile; utaimwaga juu ya ardhi kama maji.
sw.B: Usiile; imwage ardhini kama maji.
sw.R: Usiile. Imwage chini kama maji.

decisions.choice: pour it out like water: as in verse 16
decisions.reason: The rule of verse 16 is repeated almost word for word, for emphasis. See the note there.

source.text: לֹ֖א תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ לְמַ֨עַן יִיטַ֤ב לְךָ֙ וּלְבָנֶ֣יךָ אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי־תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall eat it, so that it may go well for you and for your sons after you, for you will do the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh.

en.L: You shall not eat it, so that it may go well with you and with your {{gender:children|sons}} after you, because you will do what [is] right in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Do not eat it, so that all may go well with you and your {{gender:children|sons}} after you, because you will be doing what is right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Do not eat it. Then things will go well for you and for your {{gender:children|sons}} after you, because you will be doing what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says is right.

es.L: No la comerás, para que te vaya bien a ti y a tus hijos después de ti, porque harás lo [que es] recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: No la comas, para que te vaya bien a ti y a tus hijos después de ti, porque estarás haciendo lo que es recto ante los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: No la comas. Así te irá bien a ti y a tus hijos después de ti, porque estarás haciendo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice que es correcto.

fr.L: Tu ne le mangeras pas, afin que tout aille bien pour toi et pour tes {{gender:enfants|fils}} après toi, car tu feras ce qui [est] droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ne le mange pas, afin que tout aille bien pour toi et pour tes {{gender:enfants|fils}} après toi, car tu feras ce qui est droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ne le mange pas. Alors tout ira bien pour toi et pour tes {{gender:enfants|fils}} après toi, car tu feras ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare juste.

sw.L: Usiile, ili upate mema wewe na watoto wako baada yako, kwa kuwa utafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Usiile, ili mambo yakuendee vema wewe na watoto wako baada yako, kwa sababu utakuwa unafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Usiile. Ndipo mambo yatakuendea vema wewe na watoto wako baada yako, kwa sababu utakuwa unafanya yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema ni sawa.

decisions.choice: right in the eyes of the LORD: set against what is right in one's own eyes
decisions.reason: Verse 8 spoke of each one doing what is right "in his own eyes". Here the measure is what is right in God's eyes, as also in 6:18 and 13:19.

decisions.choice: so that it may go well with you: the promise that goes with obedience
decisions.reason: The phrase recurs in Deuteronomy (4:40; 5:16; 6:3, 18). Keeping even this small rule is part of the life with God that brings his blessing to the generations that follow.

decisions.choice: your sons: your children and descendants
decisions.reason: The word is "sons", used for all of a person's children and those who come after them.

decisions.choice: {{gender:children|sons}}
decisions.reason: The default "children" says that daughters are included; the setting gives the traditional "sons".

source.text: רַ֧ק קָֽדָשֶׁ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְי֥וּ לְךָ֖ וּנְדָרֶ֑יךָ תִּשָּׂ֣א וּבָ֔אתָ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Only your holy things which will be to you and your vows you shall carry and you shall come to the place which will choose Yahweh.

en.L: Only your holy things that you have and your vow offerings you shall take up, and you shall come to the place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will choose.
en.B: But take your holy offerings that are due from you and your vow offerings, and go with them to the place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will choose.
en.R: But take the holy gifts you owe and the gifts you promised, and go with them to the place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will choose.

es.L: Solamente tus cosas santas que tengas y tus ofrendas votivas tomarás, e irás al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escogerá.
es.B: Pero toma las ofrendas santas que te correspondan y tus ofrendas votivas, y ve con ellas al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escoja.
es.R: Pero toma las ofrendas santas que debes y lo que prometiste dar, y llévalo al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escoja.

fr.L: Seulement, tes choses saintes que tu as et tes offrandes votives, tu les prendras, et tu iras au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira.
fr.B: Mais prends les offrandes saintes dont tu es redevable et tes offrandes votives, et va avec elles au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira.
fr.R: Mais prends les dons saints que tu dois offrir et les dons que tu as promis, et va les porter au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira.

sw.L: Ila vitu vyako vitakatifu ulivyo navyo na sadaka zako za nadhiri utavichukua, nawe utakwenda mahali atakapopachagua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Lakini chukua matoleo yako matakatifu unayodaiwa na sadaka zako za nadhiri, uende na hayo yote mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapachagua.
sw.R: Lakini chukua zawadi takatifu unazopaswa kutoa na zawadi ulizoahidi, uende nazo mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapachagua.

decisions.choice: your holy things that are yours: what you have set apart for God
alternatives: the holy things that you have
decisions.reason: "Holy things" are gifts that belong to God, such as tithes and firstborn animals (verse 17). "Which will be to you" may mean the holy gifts that fall due from you, or simply those you have. Either way they are not ordinary meat.

decisions.choice: only: holy gifts keep the old rule
decisions.reason: After the freedom of verses 20-25, "only" marks the limit: what is holy must still be brought to the chosen place.

decisions.choice: that are due from you / you owe
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable take "which will be to you" as the gifts that fall due. Literal keeps "that you have", which leaves the phrase open.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ עֹלֹתֶ֨יךָ֙ הַבָּשָׂ֣ר וְהַדָּ֔ם עַל־מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְדַם־זְבָחֶ֗יךָ יִשָּׁפֵךְ֙ עַל־מִזְבַּח֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהַבָּשָׂ֖ר תֹּאכֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And you shall make your burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, on [the] altar of Yahweh your God, and [the] blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on [the] altar of Yahweh your God, and the flesh you shall eat.

en.L: And you shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God; and the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and the meat you shall eat.
en.B: Offer your burnt offerings, both meat and blood, on the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. The blood of your other sacrifices is to be poured out on the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, but you may eat the meat.
en.R: Offer your burnt offerings on the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, with their meat and their blood. For your other sacrifices, pour the blood out on the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, but you may eat the meat.

es.L: Y ofrecerás tus holocaustos, la carne y la sangre, sobre el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios; y la sangre de tus sacrificios será derramada sobre el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, y la carne comerás.
es.B: Ofrece tus holocaustos, tanto la carne como la sangre, sobre el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios. La sangre de tus demás sacrificios se derramará sobre el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, pero podrás comer la carne.
es.R: Ofrece tus holocaustos sobre el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, con su carne y su sangre. En tus demás sacrificios, derrama la sangre sobre el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, pero puedes comer la carne.

fr.L: Et tu offriras tes holocaustes, la viande et le sang, sur l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu ; et le sang de tes sacrifices sera répandu sur l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, et la viande, tu la mangeras.
fr.B: Offre tes holocaustes, la viande comme le sang, sur l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Le sang de tes autres sacrifices sera répandu sur l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, mais tu pourras en manger la viande.
fr.R: Offre tes holocaustes sur l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, avec leur viande et leur sang. Pour tes autres sacrifices, verse le sang sur l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, mais tu peux en manger la viande.

sw.L: Nawe utatoa sadaka zako za kuteketezwa, nyama na damu, juu ya madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako; na damu ya dhabihu zako itamwagwa juu ya madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, na nyama utaila.
sw.B: Toa sadaka zako za kuteketezwa, nyama pamoja na damu, juu ya madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Damu ya dhabihu zako nyingine itamwagwa juu ya madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, lakini nyama unaweza kuila.
sw.R: Toa sadaka zako za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, pamoja na nyama yake na damu yake. Kwa dhabihu zako nyingine, mwaga damu juu ya madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, lakini unaweza kula nyama.

decisions.choice: burnt offerings, the meat and the blood: the whole animal is given
decisions.reason: In a burnt offering all the meat was burned on the altar and the blood was splashed against it (Leviticus 1:5-9); the worshiper kept nothing.

decisions.choice: the blood of your sacrifices poured out; the meat eaten
decisions.reason: In a sacrifice for a meal, the blood went to the altar and the fat was burned, and the worshipers ate the meat (Leviticus 3:1-5; 7:15-16). That is the joyful meal of verses 7 and 18.

decisions.choice: on the altar: on it or against its side
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "on" or "beside". The blood was splashed against the altar or poured out at its base (Leviticus 1:5; 4:7), so it went to the altar, not on the fire.

decisions.choice: your other sacrifices
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "other" to show that burnt offerings are sacrifices too, but this rule is for the ones that are eaten.

source.text: שְׁמֹ֣ר וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֑ךָּ לְמַעַן֩ יִיטַ֨ב לְךָ֜ וּלְבָנֶ֤יךָ אַחֲרֶ֨יךָ֙ עַד־עוֹלָ֔ם כִּ֤י תַעֲשֶׂה֙ הַטּ֣וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁ֔ר בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Keep and hear all the words the these which I [am] commanding you, so that it may go well for you and for your sons after you until forever, for you will do the good and the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh your God.

en.L: Keep and listen to all these words that I am commanding you, so that it may go well with you and with your {{gender:children|sons}} after you forever, because you will do what [is] good and right in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: Be careful to obey all these words I am commanding you, so that all may go well with you and your {{gender:children|sons}} after you forever, because you will be doing what is good and right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: Be careful to obey everything I am telling you. Then things will always go well for you and your {{gender:children|sons}} after you, because you will be doing what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God says is good and right.

es.L: Guarda y escucha todas estas palabras que yo te mando, para que te vaya bien a ti y a tus hijos después de ti para siempre, porque harás lo [que es] bueno y recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios.
es.B: Ten cuidado de obedecer todas estas palabras que te mando, para que te vaya bien a ti y a tus hijos después de ti para siempre, porque estarás haciendo lo que es bueno y recto ante los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios.
es.R: Obedece con cuidado todo lo que te digo. Así siempre te irá bien a ti y a tus hijos después de ti, porque estarás haciendo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios dice que es bueno y correcto.

fr.L: Garde et écoute toutes ces paroles que je te commande, afin que tout aille bien pour toi et pour tes {{gender:enfants|fils}} après toi, pour toujours, car tu feras ce qui [est] bon et droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu.
fr.B: Veille à obéir à toutes ces paroles que je te commande, afin que tout aille bien pour toi et pour tes {{gender:enfants|fils}} après toi, pour toujours, car tu feras ce qui est bon et droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu.
fr.R: Obéis avec soin à tout ce que je te dis. Alors tout ira toujours bien pour toi et pour tes {{gender:enfants|fils}} après toi, car tu feras ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu déclare bon et juste.

sw.L: Shika na usikilize maneno haya yote ninayokuamuru, ili upate mema wewe na watoto wako baada yako hata milele, kwa kuwa utafanya yaliyo mema na sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.
sw.B: Uwe mwangalifu kuyatii maneno haya yote ninayokuamuru, ili mambo yakuendee vema wewe na watoto wako baada yako milele, kwa sababu utakuwa unafanya yaliyo mema na sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.
sw.R: Kuwa mwangalifu kutii kila kitu ninachokuambia. Ndipo mambo yatakuendea vema daima wewe na watoto wako baada yako, kwa sababu utakuwa unafanya yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anasema ni mema na sawa.

decisions.choice: keep and hear: listen and carefully obey
decisions.reason: "Hear" in Deuteronomy means to listen so as to obey (6:3-4), and "keep" means to guard and do. Together they call for careful obedience.

decisions.choice: the good and the right in the eyes of the LORD: as in 6:18
decisions.reason: The verse sums up the chapter in the words of verse 25 and 6:18, adding "good" and "forever".

decisions.choice: be careful to obey
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable join the two verbs into one plain command. Literal keeps both.

decisions.choice: {{gender:children|sons}}
decisions.reason: As in verse 25.

source.text: כִּֽי־יַכְרִית֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת־הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֛מָּה לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אוֹתָ֖ם מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֖ בְּאַרְצָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: When cuts off Yahweh your God the nations where you [are] going there to dispossess them from before you, and you dispossess them and you live in their land,

en.L: When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God cuts off from before you the nations whom you are going in to dispossess, and you dispossess them and live in their land,
en.B: When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God cuts off before you the nations you are going in to drive out, and you drive them out and settle in their land,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God will destroy the nations in the land you are going into. You will drive them out and live in their land.

es.L: Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios extirpe de delante de ti las naciones adonde tú vas para desposeerlas, y las desposeas y habites en su tierra,
es.B: Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios elimine delante de ti las naciones que vas a expulsar, y tú las expulses y te establezcas en su tierra,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios destruirá las naciones de la tierra adonde vas a entrar. Tú las expulsarás y vivirás en su tierra.

fr.L: Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu retranchera de devant toi les nations chez qui tu entres pour les déposséder, et que tu les déposséderas et habiteras dans leur pays,
fr.B: Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu aura retranché devant toi les nations que tu vas chasser, et que tu les auras chassées et te seras installé dans leur pays,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu détruira les nations du pays où tu vas entrer. Tu les chasseras et tu vivras dans leur pays.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakapoyakatilia mbali mbele yako mataifa unakoingia ili kuyanyang'anya, nawe ukayanyang'anya na kukaa katika nchi yao,
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakapoyakatilia mbali mbele yako mataifa unayoenda kuyafukuza, nawe ukayafukuza na kukaa katika nchi yao,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atayaangamiza mataifa ya nchi unayoiingia. Utayafukuza na kuishi katika nchi yao.

decisions.choice: cuts off: destroys, removes
decisions.reason: To "cut off" a people is to destroy it or remove it from the land. God is the one who does it (7:1-2; 19:1).

decisions.choice: where you are going in to dispossess them: the land you are entering
decisions.reason: The phrase means the nations in the land Israel is about to enter and take. "Dispossess" is used twice: God's act makes Israel's possible.

decisions.choice: drive out
decisions.reason: As in verse 2: "dispossess" at Literal, "drive out" at Balanced and Readable. Readable turns the opening "when" into a statement of what will happen; verse 30 then begins "When that happens".

source.text: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֗ פֶּן־תִּנָּקֵשׁ֙ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י הִשָּׁמְדָ֣ם מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וּפֶן־תִּדְרֹ֨שׁ לֵֽאלֹהֵיהֶ֜ם לֵאמֹ֨ר אֵיכָ֨ה יַעַבְד֜וּ הַגּוֹיִ֤ם הָאֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֶת־אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־כֵּ֖ן גַּם־אָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: take heed to yourself lest you be ensnared after them, after their being destroyed from before you, and lest you inquire about their gods, saying, How did serve the nations the these their gods? And I will do so, also I.

en.L: take care for yourself that you are not ensnared [to follow] after them, after they have been destroyed before you, and that you do not inquire about their gods, saying, 'How did these nations serve their gods? And I also will do so.'
en.B: be careful not to be trapped into following them after they have been destroyed before you. Do not ask about their gods, saying, 'How did these nations worship their gods? I will do the same.'
en.R: When that happens, be careful! Even after they are destroyed, do not be trapped into doing what they did. Do not ask about their gods and say, 'How did these nations worship their gods? I want to do the same.'

es.L: guárdate a ti mismo de quedar atrapado [yendo] tras ellas, después de que hayan sido destruidas delante de ti, y de indagar acerca de sus dioses, diciendo: “¿Cómo servían estas naciones a sus dioses? Yo también haré así”.
es.B: ten cuidado de no caer en la trampa de seguirlas después de que hayan sido destruidas delante de ti. No preguntes por sus dioses, diciendo: “¿Cómo adoraban estas naciones a sus dioses? Yo haré lo mismo”.
es.R: Cuando eso suceda, ¡ten cuidado! Aun después de que hayan sido destruidas, no caigas en la trampa de hacer lo que ellas hacían. No preguntes por sus dioses ni digas: “¿Cómo adoraban estas naciones a sus dioses? Yo quiero hacer lo mismo”.

fr.L: prends garde à toi, de peur que tu ne sois pris au piège [en allant] après eux, après qu’ils auront été détruits devant toi, et que tu ne t’enquières de leurs dieux, en disant : “Comment ces nations servaient-elles leurs dieux ? Moi aussi, je ferai de même.”
fr.B: garde-toi de te laisser prendre au piège en les imitant, après qu’ils auront été détruits devant toi. Ne t’informe pas de leurs dieux en disant : “Comment ces nations adoraient-elles leurs dieux ? Je ferai de même.”
fr.R: Quand cela arrivera, fais attention ! Même après leur destruction, ne te laisse pas prendre au piège en faisant comme eux. Ne pose pas de questions sur leurs dieux en disant : “Comment ces nations adoraient-elles leurs dieux ? Je veux faire la même chose.”

sw.L: jihadhari nafsi yako usije ukanaswa [kuyafuata] nyuma yao, baada ya kuangamizwa mbele yako, wala usije ukauliza habari za miungu yao, ukisema, 'Mataifa haya yaliitumikiaje miungu yao? Nami pia nitafanya hivyo.'
sw.B: jihadhari usinaswe na kuyafuata baada ya kuangamizwa mbele yako. Usiulize habari za miungu yao, ukisema, 'Mataifa haya yaliiabuduje miungu yao? Nitafanya vivyo hivyo.'
sw.R: Hayo yatakapotokea, kuwa mwangalifu! Hata baada ya kuangamizwa kwao, usinaswe na kufanya kama walivyofanya. Usiulize habari za miungu yao na kusema, 'Mataifa haya yaliiabuduje miungu yao? Ninataka kufanya vivyo hivyo.'

decisions.choice: ensnared after them: lured into following their ways
decisions.reason: A snare is a bird trap. The danger is not the nations' armies, which God will destroy, but their worship, which can catch Israel like a bird in a trap (7:16, 25).

decisions.choice: inquire about their gods: seek them out in order to copy them
decisions.reason: It is the verb "seek" of verse 5. Israel is to seek the place God chooses, not to seek out how the nations worshiped their gods.

decisions.choice: I also will do so: the wish to worship the LORD in the nations' way
decisions.reason: The speaker does not plan to leave the LORD, but to copy the nations' rites in worshiping him. Verse 31 forbids exactly that.

decisions.choice: worship
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "worship" for "serve", as in verse 2.

decisions.choice: When that happens
decisions.reason: Readable begins a new sentence here and links it to verse 29.

source.text: לֹא־תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כֵ֔ן לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּי֩ כָּל־תּוֹעֲבַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֗א עָשׂוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֣י גַ֤ם אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם֙ וְאֶת־בְּנֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם יִשְׂרְפ֥וּ בָאֵ֖שׁ לֵֽאלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall do so to Yahweh your God, for every abomination of Yahweh which he hates they have done for their gods, for even their sons and their daughters they burn in the fire to their gods.

en.L: You shall not do so to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, for every abomination to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hates, they have done for their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.
en.B: You must not worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God in that way, because for their gods they have done every detestable thing that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as offerings to their gods.
en.R: Do not worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God the way they worship their gods. When they worship their gods, they do all the disgusting things that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} hates. They even burn their own sons and daughters as sacrifices to their gods.

es.L: No harás así con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, porque toda abominación para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, la cual {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} aborrece, han hecho ellos para sus dioses; pues aun a sus hijos y a sus hijas queman en el fuego para sus dioses.
es.B: No debes adorar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios de esa manera, porque para sus dioses ellos han hecho toda cosa detestable que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} aborrece. Hasta queman en el fuego a sus hijos y a sus hijas como ofrenda a sus dioses.
es.R: No adores {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios como ellos adoran a sus dioses. Cuando adoran a sus dioses, hacen todas las cosas repugnantes que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} odia. Hasta queman a sus propios hijos e hijas como sacrificio a sus dioses.

fr.L: Tu ne feras pas ainsi pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, car toute abomination pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} hait, ils l’ont faite pour leurs dieux ; car même leurs fils et leurs filles, ils les brûlent au feu pour leurs dieux.
fr.B: Tu ne dois pas adorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu de cette manière, car pour leurs dieux ils ont fait tout ce qui est abominable, tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} hait. Ils vont jusqu’à brûler au feu leurs fils et leurs filles en offrande à leurs dieux.
fr.R: N’adore pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu comme ils adorent leurs dieux. Quand ils adorent leurs dieux, ils font toutes les choses dégoûtantes que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déteste. Ils brûlent même leurs propres fils et leurs propres filles en sacrifice à leurs dieux.

sw.L: Usimtendee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako hivyo, kwa maana kila chukizo kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambalo {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} analichukia, wamelifanya kwa ajili ya miungu yao; kwa maana hata wana wao na binti zao wanawateketeza kwa moto kwa ajili ya miungu yao.
sw.B: Usimwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa namna hiyo, kwa sababu kwa ajili ya miungu yao wamefanya kila kitu cha kuchukiza ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anakichukia. Hata huwateketeza kwa moto wana wao na binti zao kuwa sadaka kwa miungu yao.
sw.R: Usimwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako jinsi wao wanavyoiabudu miungu yao. Wanapoiabudu miungu yao, wanafanya mambo yote ya kuchukiza ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayachukia. Hata huwachoma moto wana wao wenyewe na binti zao kuwa dhabihu kwa miungu yao.

decisions.choice: you shall not do so: as in verse 4
decisions.reason: The chapter returns to the words of verse 4. There they forbade worship at the nations' places; here they forbid the nations' ways of worship.

decisions.choice: abomination: something God finds utterly detestable
decisions.reason: The word names what is loathsome and rejected, here what the LORD hates. Deuteronomy uses it of idols (7:25-26) and of the practices of the nations (18:9-12).

decisions.choice: they burn their sons and daughters: child sacrifice
decisions.reason: Some peoples of the region offered children by burning them. The law forbids it outright (18:10; Leviticus 18:21), and the prophets condemn it when it later appears in Israel (2 Kings 16:3; Jeremiah 7:31).

decisions.choice: as offerings / as sacrifices
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the burning was: an offering to their gods, which "to their gods" means.
